title: Selected Kimarite design specifications
notes: Designer selections; not a claim that every new rule has been wired into simulator. Katasukashi discard reclaim and Utchari 2 green orbs were revised after R21 testing. Scoring lives in Kimarite Card Library / Kimarite 7-Axis Scores.

cards.name: Abisetaoshi
cards.text:
WIN: Total Grip ≥ 2; Power ≥ 10.
EXCHANGE: If Power ≥ 6, gain 1 flexible Grip if you have no usable Grip; otherwise gain 1 Power.
cards.test_note: R20 tested ABI-2: 336/648 Starting, 334/648 Shuffled; approval bookkeeping pending.

cards.name: Hatakikomi
cards.text:
WIN: Momentum ≤ −2; Power ≥ 6.
EXCHANGE: You may lose 1 Momentum. If you do, your opponent discards 1 card from their hand. If their hand is empty, draw 1 card instead.

cards.name: Hikiotoshi
cards.text:
WIN: Grip ≥ 1; Momentum ≤ −2; Position ≥ 0.
EXCHANGE: Look at the top 3 cards of your Draw Pile. Put 1 into your hand and the others on the bottom of your Draw Pile.

cards.name: Katasukashi
cards.text:
WIN: Your opponent has no Grip; Momentum ≥ 1; hand advantage ≥ 5.
EXCHANGE: If Momentum ≥ 1, choose 1 card from your Discard Pile and put it into your hand.

cards.name: Kirikaeshi
cards.text:
WIN: Your Power is at least 3 below your opponent's; you have more cards in hand than your opponent; you made a successful Reversal this turn.
EXCHANGE: Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Kotenage
cards.text:
WIN: Your opponent has no Grip; Momentum ≥ 1; you have ≥ 5 cards in hand.
EXCHANGE: Reduce an opponent's Grip by 1 level. If they have no Grip, you may draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
cards.test_note: R20 tested KOT-1: 353/648 Starting, 324/648 Shuffled; balance approval pending.

cards.name: Okuridashi
cards.text:
WIN: You made a successful Reversal this turn; Position ≥ 1; Momentum ≥ 1.
EXCHANGE: Choose one: lose 1 Position to gain 2 Momentum, or lose 1 Momentum to gain 2 Position.
cards.test_note: R20 tested OKD-2: 307/648 Starting, 330/648 Shuffled; approval pending.

cards.name: Okuritaoshi
cards.text:
WIN: You made a successful Reversal this turn; Position ≥ 0; Momentum ≥ 2.
EXCHANGE: Choose one: lose 1 Position to gain 2 Momentum, or lose 1 Momentum to gain 2 Position.
cards.test_note: R20 tested OKT-2: 310/648 Starting, 329/648 Shuffled; approval pending.

cards.name: Oshidashi
cards.text:
WIN: Position ≥ 2; Momentum ≥ 2.
EXCHANGE: If Position ≥ 1, gain 1 Momentum.
cards.test_note: R20 tested OSH-3: 310/648 Starting, 320/648 Shuffled; designer selected.

cards.name: Oshitaoshi
cards.text:
WIN: Momentum ≥ 1; Position ≥ 1; Power ≥ 8.
EXCHANGE: If Momentum ≥ 1, gain 1 Power. Then, if your Power exceeds your opponent's, gain 1 Momentum.

cards.name: Shitatenage
cards.text:
WIN: Deep Right Grip; Momentum ≥ 1; Position ≥ 0.
EXCHANGE: If you have Right Grip, gain 1 Momentum.

cards.name: Sukuinage
cards.text:
WIN: You have no Grip; Momentum ≥ 2; hand advantage ≥ 3.
EXCHANGE: If you have no Grip, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Tottari
cards.text:
WIN: You have no active Grip; you prevented or reduced an opponent's Grip attempt during the specified turn window.
EXCHANGE: Look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's Draw Pile and discard 1 of them.

cards.name: Tsukidashi
cards.text:
WIN: Position ≥ 2; you played ≥ 3 cards this turn.
EXCHANGE: If Position ≥ 1, gain 1 Play and draw 1 card.

cards.name: Tsukiotoshi
cards.text:
WIN: You have no Grip; Momentum ≥ 1; your Power is at least 3 below your opponent's.
EXCHANGE: Gain 1 Play.

cards.name: Tsukitaoshi
cards.text:
WIN: Momentum ≥ 2; you played ≥ 3 cards this turn.
EXCHANGE: Gain 1 Play, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Tsuridashi
cards.text:
WIN: Total Grip ≥ 3; Position ≥ 0; Power ≥ 6.
EXCHANGE: Gain 1 Power. If Momentum ≥ 2, gain 1 additional Power.

cards.name: Utchari
cards.text:
WIN: You gained Momentum this turn; Position = −3.
EXCHANGE: If Position < 0, look at the top 2 cards of your Draw Pile. Put 1 into your hand and the other on the bottom of your Draw Pile.
cards.test_note: Two green orbs after R21 — untested

cards.name: Uwatedashinage
cards.text:
WIN: Left Grip ≥ 1; Momentum ≥ 1; your Power is at least 5 below your opponent's.
EXCHANGE: Draw 1 card. You may discard 1 card from your hand to establish Left Grip.

cards.name: Uwatenage
cards.text:
WIN: Deep Left Grip; Momentum ≥ 1; Position ≥ 0.
EXCHANGE: If Momentum ≥ 0, establish Left Grip.

cards.name: Yorikiri
cards.text:
WIN: Grip ≥ 1; Momentum ≥ 1; Position ≥ 2.
EXCHANGE: If Total Grip ≥ 2, gain 1 Push.

cards.name: Yoritaoshi
cards.text:
WIN: Grip ≥ 1; Position ≥ 2; your Power exceeds your opponent's by ≥ 2.
EXCHANGE: If Total Grip ≥ 1, gain 1 Power.
